name: Turing Generator Source Manifest
purpose: Defines external and internal reference sources used by the Turing Generator MVP.
source_usage_principle: External repositories may be stored locally as complete reference sources, but only curated context extracts shall be loaded into LLM prompts by default.

sources.name: SysML v2 Release Repository
sources.usage_rule: Use this source as the primary reference for SysML v2 syntax, language concepts and model libraries. Do not load the complete repository into prompts. Use curated extracts in context/sysml/ instead.

sources.name: Apollo 11 SysML v2 Example Model
sources.usage_rule: Use this source as a non-normative reference for structure, organization and modeling style in a larger SysML v2 model. Do not treat it as the final authority for SysML v2 syntax.

sources.name: Turing Generator Architecture Model
sources.usage_rule: Use the files in model/architecture/ as the architectural specification of the Turing Generator itself. These files may be read for context but shall not be modified unless explicitly requested.

sources.name: Approved Input Artifacts
sources.usage_rule: Only content that has passed the ingestion review gate may be stored here. Downstream candidate generation shall use approved input rather than raw legacy data.

sources.name: Generated SysML v2 Output
sources.usage_rule: Generated SysML v2 model artifacts shall be written to data/output/. This folder contains output produced by the Turing Generator, not the architecture model of the generator itself.

global_rules.rule: Do not treat external example repositories as legacy input unless a task explicitly defines them as input.
Do not load complete external repositories into LLM prompts by default.
Use curated context files for routine prompting.
Use the SysML v2 release repository as primary syntax and language reference.
Use the Apollo 11 SysML v2 repository only as a non-normative structure and style reference.
Generated SysML v2 output belongs in data/output/.
The architecture model of the Turing Generator belongs in model/architecture/ and shall not be overwritten by generated output.
Raw legacy data must pass an ingestion review gate before it can become approved input.
